Warranty Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period: After having been notified of the defects / service requirement during warranty period, Seller has to complete the required Service / Rectification within 3 days time limit. OEM Must Have Registered Office in Kerala with GST Certificate. 5. OEM Should Have Twenty Years Direct Presence in Kerala. 6. Bidder or OEM Should Have Single Work Order with Value Not Less Than Twenty-Five Lakhs on Same Pr oduct (Attach Gem Work Order Copy). 7. Bidders Must Upload Bid Specific OEM Authorization Letter. 8. OEM or Bidder Should have service centre in Trivandrum. 9.Bidder Must Have Minimum Four Star or Higher Gem Rating. 10. OEM Should Have Customer Care Toll Free Number For 24hours. 11. Product Should Have Bis Certification (Proof Should Be Attached). 12. The Bidder Should Submit Product Quality Test Certificate from Authorized Agency.
